title: Aktueller Livetest: 9C-2c Ordinary-Passive durch Training (Hauptweg), Rare-Passive durch Kampf (Zusatz) (.49)
brief: Create a Mage with Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward. Your primary objective is to legitimately develop ONE Ordinary Passive by real training and accept it. Train a lasting quality of yourself, your mind: once each in-game day, explicitly spend two hours on focused practice of your concentration (for example: I spend two hours in meditation, drilling my concentration), then sleep until morning, and repeat. One such session a day is all that counts (more on the same day adds nothing); the engine needs about ten days of it. Read #skills now and then for the learning goal and its Learning Progress, and #passives for your Passive slots. Do not invent progress, a teacher, a blessing or a shortcut; if the System answers NOT TRAINING or NO PASSIVE YET, or the progress does not rise on a new day, treat it as a blocker and report it instead of repeating. Only when the System shows POSSIBLE PASSIVE, read #passives (it is offered, not yours yet), then explicitly accept it in one clear sentence (for example: I accept it). After the System reports NEW PASSIVE, read #status (INT must read like INT 8 (6 +2), Max MP higher), #skill Arcane Bolt (Raw Power with the raised INT) and #passives (1/4). Follow System state, not narrator claims. Secondary, only after that and only if it happens naturally: a Rare Passive can be offered only after an outstanding fight you win at very low HP against a much stronger foe; never seek a hopeless fight or provoke one on purpose, and do not fake danger. If any POSSIBLE PASSIVE appears, decide on it deliberately (accept or decline) and note what the System says. No Guild quest or dungeon is required. Do not manipulate engine state, use developer shortcuts or reset the chat to force success.

milestones.goal: Create a Mage with Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward.
Train your mind on your own, two hours on each of about ten in-game days with sleep between, until the System offers a POSSIBLE PASSIVE.
Accept the offered Passive explicitly and verify #status, #skill Arcane Bolt and #passives against it.
Optional: only if an outstanding, genuinely dangerous fight happens naturally and you win it at very low HP, note the Rare offer and decide on it.

focus: An Ordinary Passive comes only from real, booked training over many in-game days (20 Learning Progress per day, 200 needed); one session or repeated sessions on one day must not unlock it.

The engine offers it first (POSSIBLE PASSIVE): before your acceptance nothing about you changes (#status, Max MP, Raw Power); the narrator must not tell a new power or a stronger mind before NEW PASSIVE.

After acceptance: INT shows the bonus separately (INT 8 (6 +2)), the assigned INT stays 6, Max MP rises by 16, Arcane Bolt's Raw Power uses the raised INT; #passives shows 1/4 with the quality Ordinary.
Record the exact name of the Passive and that the name and effects were the same when offered and when gained.
If a Rare offer appears, it must come only after the fight is over (never during it) and name an outstanding victory at low HP; declining must leave nothing changed.
Observe stalls, repeated offers, offers that grant nothing or more than shown, errors, unexpected extra LLM calls and Forge timing (the call table now counts Forge calls as forge).
personas: Patient test player: train one quality of yourself every day without shortcuts, accept the offered Passive explicitly
Mechanics observer: read #skills, #passives, #status and #skill; compare offer, acceptance and the actual values with the narration
